g.text: platform/windows: the collectors and the other adapters
Fast collectors, on the tick thread
Slow collectors, on the slow-collector thread
OpenProcess, then the token's owner and elevation
Each class lists the Windows APIs it calls. A collector's stereotype names the interface in
monitoring's collector.h that it implements; it converts what Windows returns to domain
values, and its constructor takes the readers that tests replace with fakes.
The callbacks of the notifications run on OS thread-pool threads. They store a value or mark
a cache stale, and wake the slow-collector thread or the network-name worker.
